annotator: ONE LLM annotator. NOT human annotation; no second annotator; no kappa.
protocol: Real RSS headline titles from 35 outlets, fetched 2026-11-15; labels decided from the text alone; picked by the annotator from a random pool, so not a random sample. DEV ONLY: used for retrieval few-shot and tuning; never mixed into data/eval.
overlap_check: A content-word overlap check against data/eval/eval_v2 headlines found 11 same-story dev headlines (same event, different outlet); they were REMOVED from dev, and the one prompt anchor from such a story was replaced. Remaining pairs below a word-overlap threshold of 0.2 (Jaccard) and fewer than 3 shared content words were not found by the check.
